scope: Exact retained SWAP 4.3.1/B1.11 exchange meteorology writer and crop event ordering; NO claim for internal MOD_meteo normal writer

observations.proof: Main day-start loop calls TimeControl(2), then Meteo(2) if iCaller/=2 or handle_exchange(22) if iCaller==2, then croprotation(2) if swcrop==1.
DLL external exchange task22 assigns tmn=toswap%tmin; tmx=toswap%tmax; tav=(tmx+tmn)*0.5d0; tavd=(tmx+tav)*0.5d0; temperature in deg C.
germination(task=3) imports atmosphere_interface:tav; SWGERM1/2 uses tav in daily temperature sum; default SWGERM0 does not execute germination temperature sum.

cropemergence checks previous-day prep/sow/germ then initializes and updates daily; preparation and sowing gate germination; no proof that current-day full hydraulic trajectory is accepted before event evaluation.

hard_constraints: Never label a caller-declared daily TAV as committed F-KT-accepted weather without owner-issued evidence.
Never substitute WOFOST daytime_average_temperature for atmosphere_interface:tav; daytime average is semantically distinct.
Maintain daystart ordering of weather acquisition and crop rotation. A design that requires the accepted END of the SAME day before computing daystart germination is not source-faithful.
Separate day-start weather record provenance, preceding accepted hydraulic state provenance, and eventual accepted daily crop state publication; no time-travel future acceptance.
Normal iCaller/=2 route uses MOD_meteo:Meteo(2); its exact writer is not in the checked-in B1.11 retained snapshot and must remain OPEN.
Uncertified source and abbreviated/different accepted intervals fail closed. Reject/retry semantics must distinguish weather-day record from trial-generated rates.
